visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Extreme close-up shot focusing on a silver metal fork piercing a bright, runny orange egg yolk on top of a plate of reddish pasta. The lighting is bright and directional, highlighting the liquid texture of the yolk and the glossy sauce. (2) Medium shot of a young man with black hair and glasses, wearing a light green Patagonia t-shirt. He is holding a blue bowl and vigorously eating pasta with a fork, showing a satisfied facial expression. (3) The man stands at a restaurant counter, holding a small glass jar of 吃完啦 garlic chili sauce with a red label. He gestures with his hand while speaking to a chef wearing a khaki t-shirt and an apron. (4) A series of cooking close-ups showing ingredients being added to a black frying pan: tinned tuna, sliced red onions, green capers, black olives, three large spoons of red chili sauce, and tomato puree. Steam rises from the pan under bright kitchen lights. (5) Close-up of the chef using metal tongs to swirl cooked pasta in the rich red sauce within the pan. He then plates the pasta into a blue bowl, garnishing it with toasted almond flakes, arugula, and a fried egg. (6) Detailed close-up shots of the final dish, showing the man breaking the egg yolk and mixing it into the noodles. The lighting is warm and inviting, emphasizing the appetizing colors and textures of the food. (7) The man holds a white and red printed menu flyer featuring the 煙花女鮪魚麵 dish and the chili sauce brand. The background shows the restaurant interior with wooden tables and green chairs. (8) Exterior wide shots of the restaurant storefront with a blue and white FUN PASTO sign. The street background is typical of a Taiwanese urban area with various business signs and scooters nearby.
